role: CI gate over all visible Markdown: relative links resolve (rule 1), backtick-quoted repo paths exist (rule 3), and no paragraph quotes a number next to an integer .ci budget filename (rule 2).
toplevel: cd to repo root. Python: VISIBLE = `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard` (None -> filesystem existence). markdown_files skips SKIP_DIRS substrings and non-visible files. Rule 1: `[..](target)` non-http/mailto/# targets, anchor stripped, must be visible relative to the doc. Rule 3: CODE_PATH backtick spans with swift/md/sh/yml/yaml/plist/xcprivacy/entitlements (+ optional :N), minus CODE_PATH_ALLOW, must exist relative to root or doc, or (bare filename only) match any tracked basename. Rule 2: for integer-valued .ci/*.txt, a line naming the file plus next line containing a 2-6 digit number (not followed by . or %) is reported unless a backtick span with cat/head/read_budget is present. Reports each class; any -> exit 1; else 'clean'. Lines 202/210/213/220/223 are Python print() calls (inventory lists them as units). Wired: gates.yml, ci.yml, Makefile doc-links.
